name: GA Cubers Warm Up 2026
information:
This competition will **not** hold the 3x3x3 speedsolving event. There will be side events in the morning and afternoon, and in the middle of the day, the [CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastFMCChampionship2026) will be held at the same location. If you want to compete in FMC, you must sign up for that competition separately.

The closest parking area is the [Student Center Deck](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Student+Center+Parking+Deck+-+Visitor+Area+3%2FW02/@33.7744801,-84.4010697,483m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m14!1m7!3m6!1s0x88f5048ea3eb8fa1:0x3e4111b0dbacc6a6!2sInstructional+Center!8m2!3d33.7754478!4d-84.4012498!16s%2Fg%2F11c1n7f4t3!3m5!1s0x88f5048eb5a324cf:0x1df7c282263ead87!8m2!3d33.7741942!4d-84.4006866!16s%2Fg%2F11h7f7kc19!5m1!1e1?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDEyNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D). Parking is $2/hr up to a maximum $15/day.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTEyNzEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--48835820c0a2f7db4e39fda9f905a4bf335614a0/sexy.png)
This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastFMCChampionship2026#70504-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
